ننطوي (form VII)
# نَنْطَوِي (nanṭawī) /nan.tˤa.wiː/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِنْطَوَى (inṭawā)
# نَنْطَوِيَ (nanṭawiya) /nan.tˤa.wi.ja/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِنْطَوَى (inṭawā)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
